jobs.prompt: Swarm plumbing bug: a Cursor job fails with 'Coordinator failed: ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir .../swarm-cursor/<run>-<job>/swarm-test-tmp-XXXX' (seen twice on T-0090). In tools/swarm/core-71.mjs the scratch directory cleanup (the fs.rm of scratchDir near line 186) throws when a test process the worker started is still writing into it, and the exception fails the whole job even though the work completed. Make scratch cleanup best-effort: pass maxRetries 5 and retryDelay 200 to fs.rm, and if it still throws, record the message in the job's cleanupError field (the field already exists) and carry on; the job status must not change because of cleanup. Do the same for the codex scratch path if it shares the code. Add tests in tests/scratch-cleanup.test.mjs: a scratch dir that a background writer keeps refilling for a short time is removed after retries; a dir that cannot be removed (make the parent read-only on a temp dir, skip the test on a platform where that does not work) leaves the job complete with cleanupError set. Keep tests/cursor-adapter.test.mjs, tests/codex-adapter.test.mjs, tests/cursor-claims.test.mjs and tests/lanes-run.test.mjs passing.
